evaluation.discordance_upper: one-sided exact binomial alpha=0.05/21, maximum across contrasts
evaluation.random_inference: conditional on frozen sets; no population of random masks
evaluation.unknown_accuracy: worst-case bounds; all assigned families retained

historical_native_reuse: not compatible with new runtime/cap without exact evidence
question: At common routed-expert byte retention, does state-balanced selection preserve accuracy better than pooled labelled-token frequency using the same observations?
sampling: model-native settings; one deterministic family seed shared across arms/models

selection.balanced: mean across classes of mean across supported families of within-family class selected-slot shares
selection.family_weight: each family has weight one; each member question has weight 1/family_size
selection.final_fit: all historical training families before any pilot outcome
selection.frequency: sum of family-weighted counts divided by family-weighted labelled slot mass; equal total weight per family, pooled by observed token mass within that weighting
selection.quotas: equal retention per routed layer and per native contiguous expert group
selection.random: SHA256(seed,model,layer,group,original expert); same set in every fold

transitions.adjacency: consecutive original sentence indices in one reasoning segment; gaps break adjacency
transitions.dwell: observed sentence count/token sum; gaps and segment endpoints censored

verification_campaign: preserve sources, accepted jobs and protected ownership
